- **Objective:** unconditional Lean proof or falsification of RH. Endless loop: conjecture → proof or
  kill → mandatory positive salvage → next conjecture. Survivors that are dependency-closed on paper are

## Operating constraints

- Other agents run loops today on WL, LA, LI, TT, PM, RW, MC, HF(Krein). This loop avoids editing their
  modules/cards; it may cite their results.
- Search the corpus before each topic; do not judge novelty from training data.
- Every cycle row: conjecture, mechanism, verdict, positive survivor, Lean status.

## Shared open core (read before each cycle)

Every active route lands on one RH-strength statement with no slack: a one-sided bound at scale `√X`
for the integrated Chebyshev deficit (WL/MC/RW/SZ are exact restatements), equivalently no zero with
`Re ρ > ½`. Known killers every producer must survive:
- continuous Beurling countermodel with arbitrarily regular integers and a prescribed off-line zero
  (R:BeurlingRegularIntegersOffLineZeros); integer-supported Beurling floor (MUST-526);
- Davenport–Heilbronn type (functional equation without Euler product);
- single-prime deletion (R:WeilSinglePrimeDeletion), Mellin-diagonal/Helson blindness (KR-R2);
- real-support Weil-positive systems exist (MUST-523), so integrality of `log ℕ` must be used.

- 2026-10-01 — Levinson threshold observation (after cycle 78, paper-level; not formalized).
  - Levinson's detector `ζ + ζ'/L` equals `ξ + λξ'` up to a slowly varying archimedean factor,
    with `λ = 2/L`. Indeed `ξ'/ξ = ζ'/ζ + arch'`, `arch' = ½ log(t/2π) + O(1/t)`, and
    `λ/(1 + λL/2) = 1/L` forces `λ = 2/L`.
  - On the left edge `σ = −1`, `Re(1 + λξ'/ξ) = 1 − λ(½ log(t/2π) + O(1))`, which changes sign
    exactly at `λ = 2/L`.
  - For `λ < 2/L` the left-edge winding is trivial. The remaining obstruction is the horizontal
    edges near on-line zeros, where `λ Re ξ'/ξ` can exceed 1; that would need heights at distance
    `≫ 1/L` from ordinates.
  - For `λ ≥ 2/L` (Levinson's side) left zeros of `ξ + λξ'` can proliferate, and the Levinson
    inequality `N₀ ≥ N − 2N_left(V)` carries information.
  - RESOLVED by cycle 80 [L].
    - The corpus Levinson detector `ζ + λζ'` with `λ > 0` in the `Y > 0` range has exactly
      `N_right(ζ)` zeros right of the line.
    - Its spawned zeros go left.
    - The window inequality's `[½, 4]` count is `N_right + Σ_on(m − 1)`.
    - The earlier "Levinson ⟺ `N_left(V) ≥ N_left(ξ)`" sentence was wrong and is withdrawn.

- 2026-10-01 — cycle 82 (direct attack, FAILED). Levinson positivity as an RH producer.

  **Target.**
  - Exactness (MUST-607) turns the windowed RH statement into "`ζ + λζ'` has no zeros in the right window".
  - Sufficient: some mollifier `Ψ` with `Re(GΨ) > 0` on the boundary of `[½+δ, 2] × [T₁, T₂]`.
  - On the line, `GH = ξ(1 − λA) + λξ'`, so `GΨ` need not vanish at on-line zeros of `ζ`.
  - Winding check: `Δ_line arg G = −2πN_right(ζ) + O(log T)`, and `Δ_line arg Ψ = −2πZ_Ψ + O(log y)`.
    So pointwise positivity is consistent with the argument principle. There is no topological
    obstruction. (A first computation with `ξ`'s winding `πN` was wrong: that term belongs to the
    Gamma factor, not to `G`.)

  **Zero-side floor.**
  - Spawned zeros sit left of the line, at `s − ρ₀ ≈ −λ/(1 − λA)`.
  - For `σ₀` between the line and the spawned zeros, Littlewood's mass of `G` in `Re s > σ₀` is
    exactly the off-line mass.
  - So the CANNOT-322 exponential floor (which comes from on-line zeros at `λ = 0`) is absent for
    `λ > 0`. Jensen then only forces `Msq ≥ T(1 − o(1))`.

  **Obstruction.**
  - Mean-square level: Selberg's diagonal loss `∫|GΨ|² ≳ T(1 + (1/θ)∫P'²) ≥ T(1 + 1/θ)` for
    mollifiers of length `T^θ` as `R → 0`. Then `N_right ≤ N·log(1 + 1/θ)/(2R)`, which is useless
    for small `R`. 100% would need `θ → ∞`: the length barrier.
  - Pointwise level: `Re(GΨ) > 0` needs control of large values of `GΨ − 1`, whose variance is
    `≍ 1/θ`, so the event `|GΨ − 1| ≥ 1` has positive measure.
  - Both are the MC/HF terminus (`Re(gξ) > 0` on `∂D`, Nehari). No new producer.

  **Survivor.** For `λ > 0`, Levinson's method has no zero-side floor at abscissae above the spawn
  line. Its entire loss is the mollifier floor `1 + 1/θ` [P, heuristic; the spawn-distance law is not
  proved — on-line zero clusters could move spawned zeros].

(1) RIEMANN-SUM BLINDNESS LEMMA (general, ζ-free): if g is L-Lipschitz, g(log n) = 0 for all n ≥ N₀ ≥ 2, and g has compact support, then |∫_{log N₀}^∞ g(y)e^{y/2}dy| ≤ √2·L/√(N₀−1). On I_n = [log n, log(n+1)], |g(y)| ≤ L(y − log n), e^{y/2} ≤ √(n+1), |I_n| ≤ 1/n, so ∫_{I_n}|g|e^{y/2} ≤ L√(n+1)/(2n²), and Σ_{n≥N₀} n^{−3/2} ≤ 2/√(N₀−1) by telescoping. Blindness at ALL integers makes the far pole O(L e^{−Y/2}): far-lag pole mass needs roughness. (2) Pole = ∫g(y)cosh(y/2)dy (linear in g). Near part (|y| ≤ Y): per test |R_k(y)| ≤ Σ_{ij}|a_ia_j||ψ(y−d_ij)|, ∫|ψ| ≤ δ‖φ‖², and Schur with ≤ 2 + 2(Y+δ)/s partners per bump within Y+δ gives ≤ δe^{(Y+2δ)/2}(2 + 2(Y+δ)/s)·C₀, C₀ = Σc_k‖f_k‖² = g(0). Far part: (1) with L = sup|g′| ≤ Σc_k‖f_k‖‖f_k′‖ = (κ/δ)C₀. (3) Lévy per test: weilArchRe_k ≥ (A(0) + e^{−s/2}log((s−δ)/δ))‖f_k‖² + 2P_k. Summed: Σc_k weilArchRe_k ≥ (A(0) + gain)C₀ − 2|P(g)|. Choose e^{Y/2} = η/δ with η = s e^{−s/2}/64. The near part is then ≤ e^{−s/2}log(1/δ)C₀/8 + O(1), the far part ≤ √2κ·64e^{s/2}/s·C₀ = O(1), and the gain is Θ(log 1/δ). THEOREM (paper): ∀ s, κ ∃ δ₀: PBAP holds on the narrow-bump cone (any number of tests, positions, amplitudes, bump signs) for δ < δ₀. LAW: cone-level PBAP violators cannot be decomposed into well-separated narrow pieces of controlled internal frequency. They need overlapping/low-frequency mass (the anomaly) AND internal frequency κ/δ ≫ e^{Y/2}-scale roughness at far lags (chirps). |
